_about: The Spirit side by side (plan 7.6b): wordings of the Spirit that more than one book shares, from creation and the judges to the prophets, the Gospels, Acts and the letters, with what is alike and what differs. Every quotation machine-checked against the Berean; rows chosen and drafted by Claude Opus from the passages the theme map cites, the Berean editors' quotation notes and a search of the whole Berean; widened by the completeness search; every Alike and Different line read by the nine-reader panel (Sonnet). Takes no interpretive stance. A cell [verse, words, "aside"] is off the subject and shown, with an asterisk, for its shared words.
columns_note: The Law & history: Genesis to Esther. Psalms & wisdom: Job to the Song of Solomon. The Prophets: Isaiah to Malachi.

rows.title: The Spirit of the LORD came upon him

The Law & history: the Spirit of God came upon him
The Spirit of the LORD came upon him
the Spirit of the LORD came upon Gideon
the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jephthah
the Spirit of the LORD came powerfully upon him
the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him
the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him
the Spirit of God rushed upon him
the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon David from that day forward
the Spirit of God came upon Azariah son of Oded
the Spirit of the LORD came upon Jahaziel
the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest
Gospels & Acts: The Holy Spirit will come upon you
the Holy Spirit was upon him

rows.alike: In each the Spirit comes upon someone: "The Spirit of the LORD came upon him" (Judges 3:10), "the Spirit of God came upon Azariah son of Oded" (2 Chronicles 15:1), "The Holy Spirit will come upon you" (Luke 1:35).
rows.different: Judges and 1 Samuel tell what those the Spirit came on did next: Othniel "went out to war", Samson "tore the lion apart"; Judges and Samuel also say "came powerfully", "came mightily" and "rushed upon". 2 Chronicles 24:20 has Zechariah then stand up and say "This is what God says". In Luke 1:35 the angel adds "the power of the Most High will overshadow you"; of Simeon Luke says "the Holy Spirit was upon him".

rows.title: The Spirit fell upon them

The Prophets: the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me and told me to declare
Gospels & Acts: the Holy Spirit had not yet fallen upon any of them
the Holy Spirit fell upon all who heard his message
the Holy Spirit fell upon them, just as He had fallen upon us at the beginning

rows.alike: The Spirit "fell upon" someone: "the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me" (Ezekiel 11:5), "the Holy Spirit fell upon all who heard his message" (Acts 10:44).
rows.different: In Ezekiel the Spirit "fell upon me and told me to declare" a message to "O house of Israel". In Acts the words are said of groups: of some, "had not yet fallen upon any of them", of others "upon all who heard his message", and one speaker adds "just as He had fallen upon us at the beginning".

rows.title: The Spirit rested on them, and they prophesied

The Law & history: As the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied

Gospels & Acts: was filled with the Holy Spirit and prophesied
the Holy Spirit came upon them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied
Revelation: the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy

rows.alike: The Spirit comes upon people and they prophesy: "As the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied" (Numbers 11:25), "the Spirit of God rushed upon him, and he prophesied along with them" (1 Samuel 10:10), "the Holy Spirit came upon them, and they spoke in tongues and prophesied" (Acts 19:6).
rows.different: Numbers says of the seventy elders "they never did so again", and Moses answers "I wish that all the LORD's people were prophets"; in 1 Samuel the Spirit comes on Saul and on "Saul's messengers". Luke has Zechariah "filled with the Holy Spirit", and Acts 19:6 adds "spoke in tongues". Revelation has the phrase "the spirit of prophecy": "the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy".

rows.title: Filled with the Spirit, full of the Holy Spirit

The Law & history: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with skill, ability, and knowledge
He has filled him with the Spirit of God
The Prophets: I am filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD
Gospels & Acts: he will be filled with the Holy Spirit even from his mother's womb
Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit

Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit
they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly
a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit
Stephen, full of the Holy Spirit
be filled with the Holy Spirit
full of the Holy Spirit and faith
the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit
The letters: Instead, be filled with the Spirit

rows.alike: Each says someone is "filled with" or "full of" the Spirit: "I have filled him with the Spirit of God" (Exodus 31:3), "I am filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD" (Micah 3:8), "they were all filled with the Holy Spirit" (Acts 2:4), "be filled with the Spirit" (Ephesians 5:18).
rows.different: In Exodus God fills someone "with skill, ability, and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship"; Micah is filled "to declare to Jacob his transgression"; in Acts 4:31 those filled "spoke the word of God boldly", and Luke 1:15 adds "even from his mother's womb". Ephesians 5:18 has "be filled with the Spirit" as a command, set against "Do not get drunk on wine".

rows.title: The spirit of wisdom

The Law & history: whom I have filled with a spirit of wisdom
Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom
The Prophets: the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, the Spirit of counsel and strength, the Spirit of knowledge and fear of the LORD
the spirit of the gods is in you, and that you have insight, intelligence, and extraordinary wisdom
Gospels & Acts: full of the Spirit and wisdom
they could not stand up to his wisdom or the Spirit by whom he spoke
The letters: To one there is given through the Spirit the message of wisdom
a spirit of wisdom and revelation in your knowledge of Him

rows.alike: Wisdom is named with the spirit: "a spirit of wisdom" (Exodus 28:3), "the spirit of wisdom" (Deuteronomy 34:9), "the Spirit of wisdom and understanding" (Isaiah 11:2), "full of the Spirit and wisdom" (Acts 6:3), "a spirit of wisdom and revelation" (Ephesians 1:17).
rows.different: In Exodus the craftsmen are filled "to make garments for Aaron's consecration"; Joshua is filled "because Moses had laid his hands on him"; Isaiah says "The Spirit of the LORD will rest on Him" and names six together. Daniel has "I have heard that the spirit of the gods is in you". Acts 6:3 has "full of the Spirit and wisdom" in choosing seven men; 1 Corinthians lists "the message of wisdom" as given "through the Spirit"; Ephesians is a prayer that God "may give you" a spirit of wisdom.

rows.title: The Spirit rested on Him

The Law & history: As the Spirit rested on them
The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha
The Prophets: The Spirit of the LORD will rest on Him
Gospels & Acts: He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and resting on Him
the Spirit descending on Him like a dove
the Holy Spirit descended on Him in a bodily form like a dove
I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove and resting on Him
The man on whom you see the Spirit descend and rest
The letters: the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you

rows.alike: The Spirit "rests on" someone: "the Spirit rested on them" (Numbers 11:26), "The Spirit of the LORD will rest on Him" (Isaiah 11:2), "descending like a dove and resting on Him" (Matthew 3:16), "rests on you" (1 Peter 4:14).
rows.different: In Numbers the Spirit rests on the seventy elders, and 2 Kings speaks of "The spirit of Elijah" resting on Elisha; Isaiah has it in the future: "will rest on Him". Matthew 3:16 has "As soon as Jesus was baptized, He went up out of the water" and then the Spirit "descending like a dove and resting on Him"; the Gospels add "like a dove"; Mark and Luke say "descending" and "descended" without "resting". 1 Peter speaks to those "insulted for the name of Christ".

rows.title: He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit

Gospels & Acts: He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire

He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with fire
He who will baptize with the Holy Spirit

John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit
The letters: in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body

rows.alike: Each joins baptism and the Spirit, and the Gospels and Acts set this beside John's baptism "with water": "I baptize you with water, but He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit" (Mark 1:8), "John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit" (Acts 11:16).
rows.different: Matthew and Luke add "and with fire"; Mark and John do not. In Luke 3:16 "John answered all of them"; in Acts 1:5 the words add "in a few days", and in Acts 11:16 the speaker says "I remembered the word of the Lord". 1 Corinthians has "we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, slave or free".

Gospels & Acts: the Spirit of the Lord carried Philip away
Revelation: At once I was in the Spirit
the angel carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness
he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high

rows.alike: Someone is taken from place to place by the Spirit: "the Spirit of the LORD may carry you off" (1 Kings 18:12), "the Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to Chaldea" (Ezekiel 11:24), "the Spirit of the Lord carried Philip away" (Acts 8:39), "he carried me away in the Spirit" (Revelation 21:10).
rows.different: In Kings it is others who speak: "I do not know where the Spirit of the LORD may carry you off", "he will kill me", and "Perhaps the Spirit of the LORD has taken him up". Ezekiel and Revelation speak of the writer himself, and Ezekiel 8:3 adds "in visions of God". Acts tells of Philip, and the verse begins "When they came up out of the water". In Revelation the writer says "the angel carried me away in the Spirit", and twice "I was in the Spirit".

The Prophets: the words that the LORD of Hosts had sent by His Spirit through the earlier prophets
Gospels & Acts: it will not be you speaking, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you
does David in the Spirit call Him

the Holy Spirit foretold through the mouth of David

The letters: in words taught by the Spirit

rows.alike: The Spirit speaks through people: "The Spirit of the LORD spoke through me" (2 Samuel 23:2), "through Your prophets" (Nehemiah 9:30), "through the mouth of David" (Acts 1:16), "through Isaiah the prophet" (Acts 28:25), "men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit" (2 Peter 1:21).
rows.different: In 2 Samuel the speaker says "through me"; Nehemiah and Zechariah speak of prophets who were not heeded ("Yet they would not listen"; "would not listen to the law"). In Mark 13:11 the words are for "when they arrest you and hand you over"; Matthew 10:20 says "the Spirit of your Father"; 1 Peter 1:11 says "the Spirit of Christ in them".

rows.title: What the Spirit says

Gospels & Acts: The Spirit told me to accompany them without hesitation
the Holy Spirit warns me that chains and afflictions await me
The letters: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us about this
Revelation: let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches
let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches
let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches
let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches
let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches
let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches
let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches
The Spirit and the bride say

rows.alike: The Spirit is said to speak: "The Spirit said to Philip" (Acts 8:29), "The Holy Spirit says" (Acts 21:11), "as the Holy Spirit says" (Hebrews 3:7), "what the Spirit says to the churches" (Revelation 2:7).
rows.different: In Acts the words are spoken to Philip and to Peter ("Go over to that chariot and stay by it") and in 13:2 are about "Barnabas and Saul"; Hebrews 3:7 introduces the words "Today, if you hear His voice"; Revelation repeats "He who has an ear" seven times, and has "says the Spirit" in 14:13 and "The Spirit and the bride say" in 22:17.

rows.title: Anointed, sealed, and given the Spirit as a pledge

The Law & history: Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him
the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon David from that day forward
Gospels & Acts: God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power
The letters: placed His seal on us, and put His Spirit in our hearts as a pledge of what is to come
has given us the Spirit as a pledge of what is to come
you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit
who is the pledge of our inheritance
in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption

rows.alike: Anointing and the Spirit are named together: "anointed him" and "the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon David" (1 Samuel 16:13), "God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit" (Acts 10:38), "He anointed us" (2 Corinthians 1:21).
rows.different: 1 Samuel uses "the horn of oil"; Acts 10:38 adds "and with power"; 2 Corinthians and Ephesians add a seal and a pledge: "placed His seal on us", "as a pledge of what is to come", "sealed with the promised Holy Spirit", "the pledge of our inheritance".

rows.title: By the power of the Spirit

The Prophets: I am filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD
Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit
Gospels & Acts: The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you
Jesus returned to Galilee in the power of the Spirit

The letters: by the power of the Holy Spirit
by the power of signs and wonders, and by the power of the Spirit of God
with a demonstration of the Spirit's power
strengthen you with power through His Spirit
not only in word, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit

rows.alike: The Spirit is named together with "power": "filled with power by the Spirit of the LORD" (Micah 3:8), "in the power of the Spirit" (Luke 4:14), "by the power of the Holy Spirit" (Romans 15:13).
rows.different: Zechariah has "Not by might nor by power, but by My Spirit". Romans 15:19 names "the power of the Spirit of God" beside "signs and wonders"; 1 Corinthians 2:4 has "a demonstration of the Spirit's power" beside "persuasive words of wisdom", and 1 Thessalonians 1:5 has "in power, in the Holy Spirit" beside "not only in word". Micah is filled "to declare to Jacob his transgression".

rows.title: The gift of the Holy Spirit, given and received

The Law & history: You gave Your good Spirit to instruct them
Gospels & Acts: how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him

The letters: the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us

rows.alike: God gives the Spirit and people receive the Spirit: "You gave Your good Spirit" (Nehemiah 9:20), "give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him" (Luke 11:13), "you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit" (Acts 2:38), "the Holy Spirit, whom He has given us" (Romans 5:5).
rows.different: Nehemiah has "You gave Your good Spirit to instruct them" beside "Your manna" and "water for their thirst". Luke 11:13 says "to those who ask Him" and Acts 5:32 "to those who obey Him"; Acts 19:2 and Galatians 3:2 ask questions, "when you became believers?" and "by works of the law, or by hearing with faith?". The letters also speak of "different gifts, but the same Spirit" (1 Corinthians 12:4) and "gifts of the Holy Spirit distributed according to His will" (Hebrews 2:4).

rows.title: Hands laid on, and the Spirit

The Law & history: Take Joshua son of Nun, a man with the Spirit in him, and lay your hands on him
filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid his hands on him
Gospels & Acts: Peter and John laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit
the Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles' hands
so that everyone on whom I lay my hands may receive the Holy Spirit

The letters: the gift that is in you, which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders
the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands

rows.alike: Hands are laid on someone, and the spirit or a gift is named with the laying on: "lay your hands on him" (Numbers 27:18), "because Moses had laid his hands on him" (Deuteronomy 34:9), "laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit" (Acts 8:17), "the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands" (2 Timothy 1:6).
rows.different: Numbers 27:18 calls Joshua "a man with the Spirit in him" in the same sentence as "lay your hands on him"; Deuteronomy 34:9 says he was filled "because Moses had laid his hands on him". Numbers 27:23 has "laid his hands on him and commissioned him", and does not name the Spirit. In Acts the hands are the apostles', Ananias's and Paul's. 1 Timothy 4:14 has "the hands of the elders" and 2 Timothy 1:6 "my hands"; neither verse names the Spirit.

rows.title: They rebelled and grieved His Holy Spirit

The Prophets: they rebelled and grieved His Holy Spirit
Where is the One who set His Holy Spirit among them
Gospels & Acts: You always resist the Holy Spirit, just as your fathers did
The letters: do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God

rows.alike: The Spirit is rebelled against, resisted or grieved: "they rebelled against His Spirit" (Psalm 106:33), "they rebelled and grieved His Holy Spirit" (Isaiah 63:10), "You always resist the Holy Spirit" (Acts 7:51), "do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God" (Ephesians 4:30).
rows.different: Isaiah has "His people remembered the days of old, the days of Moses", and Psalm 106:33 has "Moses spoke rashly with his lips". Isaiah adds "So He turned and became their enemy". Acts 7:51 has "You stiff-necked people with uncircumcised hearts and ears!" and "just as your fathers did". Ephesians 4:30 is a command and adds "in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption".

rows.title: Take not Your Holy Spirit from me

The Law & history: the Spirit of the LORD departed from Saul

Which way did the Spirit of the LORD go when He departed from me to speak with you?
Psalms & wisdom: Cast me not away from Your presence; take not Your Holy Spirit from me
Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?
The Prophets: My Spirit will not depart from you
My Spirit remains among you; do not be afraid
Gospels & Acts: another Advocate to be with you forever

rows.alike: Whether the Spirit leaves or stays: "the Spirit of the LORD departed from Saul" (1 Samuel 16:14), "take not Your Holy Spirit from me" (Psalm 51:11), "My Spirit will not depart from you" (Isaiah 59:21), "My Spirit remains among you" (Haggai 2:5), "to be with you forever" (John 14:16).
rows.different: 1 Samuel tells of Saul and adds "a spirit of distress from the LORD began to torment him"; in Kings and Chronicles Zedekiah puts the question to Micaiah after striking him "in the face". Psalm 51 is a prayer, and Psalm 139 asks "Where can I go to escape Your Spirit?". Isaiah calls the promise "My covenant with them"; Haggai ties it to "when you came out of Egypt"; John has "another Advocate".

rows.title: Led by the Spirit

The Law & history: You gave Your good Spirit to instruct them
Psalms & wisdom: May Your good Spirit lead me on level ground
The Prophets: the Spirit of the LORD gave them rest. You led Your people this way
Gospels & Acts: Jesus was led by the Spirit into the wilderness
the Spirit drove Jesus into the wilderness

The letters: all who are led by the Spirit of God are sons of God

rows.alike: The Spirit leads: "May Your good Spirit lead me" (Psalm 143:10), "was led by the Spirit into the wilderness" (Luke 4:1), "all who are led by the Spirit of God" (Romans 8:14); Nehemiah and the Psalm both say "Your good Spirit".
rows.different: Nehemiah says "You gave Your good Spirit to instruct them" and Isaiah says "the Spirit of the LORD gave them rest. You led Your people this way"; the Psalm is one person's prayer, "on level ground". Matthew, Mark and Luke tell of Jesus led "into the wilderness", and Mark says "drove". Romans adds "are sons of God" and Galatians "you are not under the law".

rows.title: Walk by the Spirit

The Prophets: cause you to walk in My statutes and to carefully observe My ordinances
The letters: who do not walk according to the flesh but according to the Spirit

rows.alike: The Spirit and walking are joined: "I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes" (Ezekiel 36:27), "walk by the Spirit" (Galatians 5:16), "let us walk in step with the Spirit" (Galatians 5:25).
rows.different: Ezekiel is God's promise, "cause you to walk", and names "My statutes" and "My ordinances"; Romans and Galatians set walking by the Spirit against "the flesh", and Galatians makes the walking a command.

rows.title: The fruit of the Spirit; by their fruit

The Prophets: Sow for yourselves righteousness and reap the fruit of loving devotion
you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood
Gospels & Acts: Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance
Produce fruit, then, in keeping with repentance

The letters: the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness
gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law

rows.alike: Each speaks of fruit: "the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace" (Galatians 5:22), "By their fruit you will recognize them" (Matthew 7:16), "will bear much fruit" (John 15:5), "the fruit of righteousness" (Amos 6:12; Philippians 1:11; James 3:18).
rows.different: Galatians 5:22-23 names nine: "love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, and self-control", and adds "Against such things there is no law"; Ephesians 5:9 names "the fruit of the light" as "all goodness, righteousness, and truth". Matthew 7:16 has "By their fruit you will recognize them", Matthew 12:33 "a tree is known by its fruit", and Luke 6:44 "each tree is known by its own fruit"; John 15:5 has "The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit"; Matthew 3:8 and Luke 3:8 have "fruit, then, in keeping with repentance". Hosea 10:12 has "reap the fruit of loving devotion", and Amos 6:12 says "you have turned ... the fruit of righteousness into wormwood".

rows.title: The Spirit and the flesh

The Prophets: their horses are flesh, not spirit

rows.alike: The Spirit is set against the flesh: "Flesh is born of flesh, but spirit is born of the Spirit" (John 3:6), "the flesh profits nothing" (John 6:63), "the flesh craves what is contrary to the Spirit" (Galatians 5:17).
rows.different: John 6:63 adds "The words I have spoken to you are spirit and they are life"; the letters add death and life ("you will die", "you will live"; "reap destruction", "reap eternal life"). Galatians 4:29 uses the pair of two sons, "the son born by the flesh" and "the son born by the Spirit". Isaiah 31:3 uses the pair of the Egyptians' horses, "flesh, not spirit", not of the Spirit.

rows.title: The Spirit gives life

The Prophets: I will put My Spirit in you and you will live

rows.alike: The Spirit and life are joined: "I will put My Spirit in you and you will live" (Ezekiel 37:14), "The Spirit gives life" (John 6:63; 2 Corinthians 3:6), "give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit" (Romans 8:11).
rows.different: Ezekiel adds "I will settle you in your own land"; John sets this against "the flesh profits nothing" and 2 Corinthians against "the letter kills"; Romans 8:11 speaks of "Him who raised Jesus from the dead"; 1 Peter speaks of Christ, "put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit".

rows.title: Water and the Spirit

The Prophets: I will pour water on the thirsty land, and currents on the dry ground

rows.alike: Water or washing is named with the Spirit: "I will pour water on the thirsty land" and "I will pour out My Spirit" (Isaiah 44:3), "born of water and the Spirit" (John 3:5), "Streams of living water" with "He was speaking about the Spirit" (John 7:38-39), "given one Spirit to drink" (1 Corinthians 12:13).
rows.different: In Isaiah water is poured "on the thirsty land" and the Spirit is poured out "on your descendants"; in Ezekiel 36:25 clean water is sprinkled "on you", and that verse does not name the Spirit. John 7:39 itself says "He was speaking about the Spirit". 1 Corinthians 6:11 says "washed" without naming water; 1 John 5:6 says of Jesus Christ that He "came by water and blood".

rows.title: Born of the Spirit

Gospels & Acts: no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit
spirit is born of the Spirit
So it is with everyone born of the Spirit
The letters: the son born by the Spirit

rows.alike: Birth is said to be of or by the Spirit: "born of water and the Spirit" (John 3:5), "everyone born of the Spirit" (John 3:8), "the son born by the Spirit" (Galatians 4:29).
rows.different: John 3:5 says "no one can enter the kingdom of God unless he is born of water and the Spirit", and John 3:8 adds the wind: "The wind blows where it wishes". Galatians speaks of "the son born by the Spirit", set against "the son born by the flesh", and adds "It is the same now".

rows.title: The Spirit of truth

Gospels & Acts: the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father
when the Spirit of truth comes, He will guide you into all truth
The letters: the Spirit of truth and the spirit of deception

rows.alike: John's Gospel and 1 John both say "the Spirit of truth" (John 14:17; 1 John 4:6).
rows.different: In the Gospel the words include "The world cannot receive Him" and "He will guide you into all truth"; 1 John sets "the Spirit of truth" beside "the spirit of deception", and 1 John 5:6 says "the Spirit is the truth".

rows.title: The Advocate

Gospels & Acts: He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever
Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you
The letters: we have an advocate before the Father

rows.alike: John's Gospel and 1 John both use the word "advocate": "another Advocate" (John 14:16), "an advocate before the Father" (1 John 2:1).
rows.different: In the Gospel the "Advocate" is named "the Holy Spirit" (John 14:26) and "the Spirit of truth" (John 15:26), and John 16:7 says "Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you"; 1 John names its advocate "Jesus Christ, the Righteous One", and speaks of "if anyone does sin".

rows.title: The Spirit sent

The Prophets: the Lord GOD has sent me, accompanied by His Spirit
Gospels & Acts: whom the Father will send in My name
whom I will send to you from the Father
if I go, I will send Him to you
The letters: God sent the Spirit of His Son into our hearts
the Holy Spirit sent from heaven

rows.alike: Sending is spoken of with the Spirit: "sent me, accompanied by His Spirit" (Isaiah 48:16), "whom the Father will send" (John 14:26), "God sent the Spirit of His Son" (Galatians 4:6), "sent from heaven" (1 Peter 1:12).
rows.different: In Isaiah the one speaking is sent "accompanied by His Spirit"; John has "will send"; Galatians has "God sent" and 1 Peter "sent from heaven", and Galatians adds "into our hearts, crying out".

rows.title: The promise of the Spirit

The Prophets: This is the promise I made to you when you came out of Egypt. And My Spirit remains among you
Gospels & Acts: I am sending the promise of My Father upon you
wait for the gift the Father promised
received from the Father the promised Holy Spirit
This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off
The letters: that by faith we might receive the promise of the Spirit
sealed with the promised Holy Spirit

rows.alike: The Spirit is spoken of as promised: "the promise I made to you" with "My Spirit remains among you" (Haggai 2:5), "the promised Holy Spirit" (Acts 2:33; Ephesians 1:13), "the promise of the Spirit" (Galatians 3:14).
rows.different: Haggai dates the promise to "when you came out of Egypt"; Luke 24:49 speaks of "the promise of My Father" and Acts 1:4 of "the gift the Father promised", and Acts 2:39 says "This promise belongs to you and your children and to all who are far off"; Galatians 3:14 also names "the blessing promised to Abraham".

rows.title: Poured out on them

The Prophets: the LORD has poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep
Gospels & Acts: has poured out what you now see and hear
the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out even on the Gentiles
The letters: God has poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit

rows.alike: Something is "poured out" with the Holy Spirit: "has poured out what you now see and hear" (Acts 2:33), "the gift of the Holy Spirit had been poured out" (Acts 10:45), "poured out His love into our hearts through the Holy Spirit" (Romans 5:5).
rows.different: In Acts 2:33 what is poured out is "what you now see and hear"; Acts 10:45 adds "even on the Gentiles"; in Romans what is poured out is "His love". Isaiah 29:10 has "poured out on you a spirit of deep sleep".

rows.title: Joy in the Holy Spirit

Gospels & Acts: Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit
the disciples were filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit
The letters: righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit
fill you with all joy and peace as you believe in Him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit
the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace
with the joy of the Holy Spirit, in spite of your great suffering

rows.alike: Joy is named with the Spirit: "rejoiced in the Holy Spirit" (Luke 10:21), "filled with joy and with the Holy Spirit" (Acts 13:52), "joy in the Holy Spirit" (Romans 14:17), "the joy of the Holy Spirit" (1 Thessalonians 1:6).
rows.different: Luke speaks of Jesus as He says "I praise You, Father"; Acts of "the disciples". Romans and Galatians list joy with peace and other things ("righteousness, peace, and joy"; "love, joy, peace"), and Galatians calls them "the fruit of the Spirit"; 1 Thessalonians adds "in spite of your great suffering".

rows.title: Worship and pray in the Spirit

Gospels & Acts: the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and in truth
God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth
The letters: we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us
I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind
Pray in the Spirit at all times
we who worship by the Spirit of God

rows.alike: Worship and prayer are named with spirit or the Spirit: "worship the Father in spirit and in truth" (John 4:23), "we who worship by the Spirit of God" (Philippians 3:3), "Pray in the Spirit" (Ephesians 6:18), "praying in the Holy Spirit" (Jude 1:20).
rows.different: John 4:24 adds "God is Spirit"; Romans says "the Spirit Himself intercedes for us" when "we do not know how we ought to pray"; 1 Corinthians says "my spirit" and sets it beside "my mind".

rows.title: The Spirit of God lives in you

The Law & history: in whom the Spirit of God abides
a man with the Spirit in him
The Prophets: in whom is the spirit of the holy gods
the spirit of the holy gods is in you
the spirit of the holy gods is in you
the spirit of the holy gods in him
the spirit of the gods is in you
Gospels & Acts: He abides with you and will be in you
The letters: if the Spirit of God lives in you
His Spirit, who lives in you
the Holy Spirit who is in you
the Holy Spirit who dwells in us
the Spirit He caused to dwell in us

rows.alike: The Spirit is said to be in a person: "in whom the Spirit of God abides" (Genesis 41:38), "a man with the Spirit in him" (Numbers 27:18), "He abides with you and will be in you" (John 14:17), "if the Spirit of God lives in you" (Romans 8:9).
rows.different: In Genesis it is Pharaoh who asks "Can we find anyone like this man, in whom the Spirit of God abides?"; in Daniel the words are "the spirit of the holy gods" and "the spirit of the gods"; in Numbers the LORD says it of "Joshua son of Nun". John speaks of this as still to come ("will be in you"); the letters say "in you" and "in us", and James adds "yearns with envy".
